subject: Post-call: SOC2 gaps + audit-log & retention evidence plan
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@blueridgebank.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@blueridgebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC2 gaps + audit-log & retention evidence plan

Hi Tim / Maya —

Thanks again for a constructive 30-min call earlier. Quick recap while items are still fresh and to confirm next steps on the security/compliance side so your risk team has a single place to reference.

Key pain points you reiterated
- Audit log granularity: needs per-API request metadata and user-identification for a two-year retention window.
- Data retention & deletion: legal requires customer-scoped retention policies and a documented DPA appendix.
- Pen test evidence: you need a high-level summary and remediation timeline for our latest authorized penetration test.
- SOC 2 scope & timeline: confirmation of in-scope controls and estimated readiness before pilot.

Goals we aligned on
1) Provide an evidence package (artifact list + sample extracts) for the security team by Oct 27.
2) Confirm an audit-log retention approach and expected retrieval SLAs.
3) Share SOC 2 control mapping and our last audit summary.
4) Schedule a focused quarter-hour call with your infosec on Oct 29 to walk artifacts.

Deliverables and owners
- Evidence matrix spreadsheet (template attached) — Soojin to deliver by EOD 2026-10-23.
- Pen test summary (PDF stub + remediation timeline) — Neha to attach and call out open items by 2026-10-23.
- DPA appendix language draft (retention & deletion clauses) — Karthik to share redlines by 2026-10-26.

Open clarification items for BlueRidge
- Can you confirm the required retention baseline (24 months vs 36 months)?
- For audit log exports: do you need real-time streaming or daily batch exports?

Attachments in this message: soc2-evidence-matrix-template.xlsx (spreadsheet, template)

Next steps
- Tim/Maya: confirm retention baseline and preferred export cadence.
- Redwood: circulate the evidence matrix + pen test summary and DPA draft per dates above.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Neha and Karthik have their pieces ready.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0143

> Tim

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@blueridgebank.com>, Maya Singh <maya.singh@blueridgebank.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 gaps + audit-log & retention evidence plan

Thanks for the recap, Soojin — added a few technical notes and flagged where we'll need BlueRidge input. I attached a short pen test summary (redacted) and added rows to the evidence matrix with examples.

Technical notes (high level)
- Audit logs: our platform records per-request metadata including model id, route, timestamp, caller API key hash, and token counts. We can export these as newline-delimited JSON (ndjson) or push via S3/HTTPS.
- Retention enforcement: we support tenant-scoped retention policies today; deletion is asynchronous (within a 48-hour window) and we provide a deletion certificate for audited deletes.
- SOC 2 artifacts: we can map our control IDs to the common criteria your team uses (I'll include the mapping tab in the matrix).

Action items assigned
- Neha: attach pen_test_summary_stub.pdf and mark remediation status (done/ongoing/planned). Due 2026-10-23.
- Soojin: finalize matrix and confirm sample extract format. Due 2026-10-23.
- Karthik: DPA appendix draft (retention & audit-log export clauses). Due 2026-10-26.

I left the following as questions to the BlueRidge team in the matrix:
1) Export cadence preference (stream vs daily batch).
2) Whether the bank requires logs to be retained in-region (we can support region locking).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Product Security, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

Attachments: pen_test_summary_stub.pdf

> On Oct 20, 2026, Soojin Lee wrote:
> > [original call notes]

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@blueridgebank.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@blueridgebank.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 gaps + audit-log & retention evidence plan

Hi Soojin / team —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side:
- Retention baseline: our legal team has confirmed 24 months as the minimum; they may ask for up to 36 months for certain product logs. Please assume 24 months for now.
- Export cadence: daily batch exports to our S3 are preferred; streaming is nice-to-have later.
- Regional constraint: logs must be stored in the US for this initial pilot.

We agree to the proposed timeline. Please ensure the pen test summary highlights any high/critical findings and remediation completion dates. If possible, add a short note about how rollback/fallback would work if a model variant triggers an incident.

Maya
Maya Singh
Security & Compliance, BlueRidge Bank
maya.singh@blueridgebank.com

On Wed, Oct 21, 2026 at 09:06 Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached pen test summary and initial mapping.
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Singh <maya.singh@blueridgebank.com>, Tim Rhodes <tim.rhodes@blueridgebank.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC2 gaps + audit-log & retention evidence plan

Maya / Tim —

Thanks for the confirmation and the scope clarifications. Quick update on next steps now that we have the retention baseline and export preference:

What Redwood will deliver by timeline
- 2026-10-23: Evidence matrix (with control mapping) + pen_test_summary_stub.pdf (Neha).
- 2026-10-26: Draft DPA appendix with retention/export language (Karthik).
- 2026-10-29: 15-min artifact walk-through with your security reviewers (calendar invite to follow).

Operational notes
- Export: we'll deliver daily NDJSON batches to a pre-authorized S3 bucket in the US. Files will include per-request metadata, and we will retain them for 24 months by default for the pilot.
- Deletion certificate: when records are purged we can generate a deletion certificate for compliance audits.
- Incident fallback: our routing supports automatic model-variant fallback and we keep immutable logs of the fallback decision chain for triage.

Please confirm: preferred time window on Oct 29 for the walk-through (we are available 10:00–12:00 PT or 15:00–17:00 PT).

I'll attach the evidence matrix and pen test summary in my follow-up EOD.

Best regards,
Soojin

Attachments to come: soc2-evidence-matrix-template.xlsx, pen_test_summary_stub.pdf
